title: Tracker Hello
description: First frame the Jetson tracker's WebSocket sends to every client on connect (needle-simulator packages/needle-jetson/.../server/websocket.py). The client checks `protocol_version` against the set it understands and reports PROTOCOL_MISMATCH when the server speaks none of them (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/ws_client.rs, SUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSIONS).
$comment: additionalProperties is true and MUST stay true: the tracker's stated rule is that additive optional fields do NOT bump protocol_version, so a strict schema here would reject a server that is, by its own contract, compatible.

protocol_version.description: Bumped only when the wire schema changes in a way the client must opt into (field rename, type change, new REQUIRED field). See TRACKER_SUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSIONS.

server_bind.description: The address the tracker bound. Used by the desktop path indicator to confirm which interface is carrying the stream.

client_addr.description: The peer address the tracker sees for this client, or 'unknown'.

phantom.description: OPTIONAL. The phantom (the box the needle moves in) this tracker is tracking, so a client never has to assume its size. A tracker that does not say (older builds) omits the object and the client must not guess a box. Additive: protocol_version is not bumped.

extent_mm.description: The visible box in the frame's own scene axes, millimetres: x = depth into the phantom, y = up to the operator-visible top (skin layer included), z = width to the right. The box the needle frames' tipX/tipY/tipZ move in.
